5836.title: Async isolation misattributes host React insertions
5836.rootCauseOneLine: An app-global isolation depth remains positive across an awaited plugin mount, so the DOM guard attributes unrelated host React commits to that plugin and refuses fresh React nodes inserted into root containers.
5836.proposedFix: Replace ambient promise-lifetime ownership with execution-scoped attribution, or a carefully specified host-commit exemption, without weakening the existing protection against plugin reparenting after await. This needs a design decision and regression coverage for both invariants.
5836.caveats: Reproduced directly with real React and the production guard in jsdom in two clean worktrees. Full browser and Windows desktop journeys were not exercised: the Browser Automation plugin could not find Chrome/Chromium. No screenshots were fabricated. The normal full build hit an unrelated missing plugin-sdk/host build artifact. No production fix or pull request was attempted because a synchronous-only change conflicts with an existing post-await isolation contract. The reports repository requires inline reproduction code/output rather than separate artifact files; all evidence needed to repeat the test is embedded in the report.
